title: Managed Database: primary correction credit — residual entitlement
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary correction credit uses the following residual entitlement basis. Add signed prior correction adjustments to the original amount, subtract the reviewed corrected target, and floor the resulting additional overcharge at zero.

## Remainder case
Hypothetical inputs: the original charge is USD 100, signed prior correction adjustments total negative USD 20, and the reviewed target is USD 65. The additional overcharge is USD 15. If the reviewed target were USD 85 instead, the floor would yield zero.
